SECTION 08 · METHOD

The Process — Brief to Brand

01 · DISCOVERDetailed brief, business goals, audience research. Site survey for signage & production projects — measurements, material study, visibility & light checks.
02 · CONCEPTMoodboards + 2–3 creative directions. Every concept must pass the silhouette test — readable at a glance, before it moves forward.
03 · DESIGNChosen direction refined in the strict brand system: 4-colour discipline, Poppins typography, negative-space craft. Structured client review rounds.
04 · PRODUCEPrint-ready & fabrication-ready files: die-lines, bleed, CMYK, material-specific artwork for flex, vinyl, ACP, acrylic, CNC & packaging.
05 · EXECUTEVendor coordination, production QC, installation supervision, on-site finishing checks, aftercare & asset archive handover.
